answer: Latency-Debt Identity Ledger. Each new identity gets a starting trust signal, but that signal decays over a fixed horizon unless refreshed by verified work. An identity that fails to refresh locks until it pays a cooldown cost measured in missed task slots, not tokens. Sybils therefore pay a rising violet-flag penalty as their unrefreshed identities accumulate, since each one consumes a ledger slot that blocks new registrations until settled.
